strings: In the early hours of the morning, m_c goes to r_c0 to ask {PRONOUN/r_c0/object} if there's anything {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can do to get rid of the monsters stalking {PRONOUN/m_c/object} when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/wake/wakes} up.
